H2_calibration.quote: Pending penalties are likely preserved by the general savings statute (1 U.S.C. § 109), but the bill doesn't say so.
H2_calibration.note: Also: 'Some ambiguities may be resolved by background law. For example, 1 U.S.C. § 1 defines "person" broadly, so the general "any person" in Sec. 3(a) reaches more than the narrow "U.S. person" definition.'
